recognize_zh: 周邊血中大型原始細胞染色質細緻、細胞質邊緣有一圈深藍色嗜鹼性環而內側較淡（A），B 圖可見細長的 Auer rod，C 圖過氧化酶染色見大顆粒狀的 pseudo-Chediak 顆粒；這組特徵是 AML with t(8;21) 的典型形態。
features: Large myeloblasts with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and high to moderate N:C ratio
Cytoplasm with a distinct deeply basophilic peripheral rim and paler inner zone
Panel B: blast with a paler perinuclear hof region and a long, slender Auer rod
Panel C (peroxidase): blasts with isolated large, coarse pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large myeloblasts with finely dispersed chromatin and cytoplasm bearing a sharply basophilic outer rim. One blast contains a long, slender Auer rod (panel B), and peroxidase staining highlights coarse pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules in some blasts (panel C). These morphologic features in circulating myeloblasts are strongly suggestive of AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1, which was confirmed by karyotype.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with heavy azurophilic granules or bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) rather than round-nucleated blasts with a basophilic rim and single long Auer rods.
Inv(16) AML shows monocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils containing large basophilic granules in the marrow.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation, not otherwise specified
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so the distinction requires cytogenetic or molecular detection of RUNX1::RUNX1T1, supported by CD19/PAX5 and CD56 coexpression on flow.
